title: Align direct natural relation-block scalar bound
finding: G1-TENSOR-01AK bounded NaturalSemiring operands and results, but the direct TypedRelationBlock constructor validates only non-negative integer kind and structural zero. A caller could therefore retain and serialize a natural scalar larger than the semiring's 4096-bit execution envelope without invoking NaturalSemiring arithmetic.
primary_claim: Direct natural TypedRelationBlock construction now fails closed above the same MAX_NATURAL_BITS envelope used by NaturalSemiring, closing the retention bypass without adding a numeric wrapper, backend, registry, or second scalar contract.
gardener_decision: Reuse the existing MAX_NATURAL_BITS constant at the retention boundary. Do not introduce bigint wrapper types, a second numeric configuration, or a parallel relation-block constructor.
acceptance: direct CSR construction accepts the largest natural scalar inside the existing 4096-bit envelope
direct CSR construction rejects a natural scalar above that envelope before it can be retained or serialized
existing scalar-kind and structural-zero refusals remain intact
NaturalSemiring arithmetic semantics and the Fourfold/Forest authority boundary remain unchanged
no OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, or benchmark superiority claim is created

verification.claim: Only exact-head executed workflow steps count as evidence.

rollback: Revert the G1-TENSOR-01AL commit; canonical Forest/Fourfold artifacts and identities are unchanged.
